ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Rougether reads your calendar to import events as to-dos. It never writes to your calendar.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Rougether reads your calendar to import events as to-dos. It never writes to your calendar.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Rougether does not use Reminders. Only calendar events are read and imported as to-dos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to pick a screenshot from your library to attach to a bug report.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Used to save a picture of your room to your library.
